title: An object with no status field
prompt: What does this return? Work it out by reading it, then reveal the answer.

explanation.approach: Since this object has no `status` field, the `update` does nothing. Both `id` and `priority` are unchanged. This is why the trap matters: the missing field silently breaks the logic.
